Test Description: Verify that a registered user can log in with valid username and password.
Test Steps:
1. Open banking login page
2. Enter valid username
3. Enter valid password
4. Click Log In
Expected Result: Customer lands on dashboard and session is created

Test Description: Verify login fails when password is incorrect.
Test Steps:
1. Open login page
2. Enter valid username
3. Enter invalid password
4. Click Log In
Expected Result: Login fails and a generic authentication error is shown

Test Case Name: Lock account after multiple failed attempts
Test Description: Verify account is locked after configured rejected attempts.
Precondition: Customer account is eligible for lockout
Test Steps: 1. Attempt login with wrong password multiple times\n2. Re-check account state
Expected Result: Account gets locked and customer must reset or contact support

Test Description: Verify session expires after configured inactivity period.
Test Steps: 1. Stay idle for timeout period\n2. Attempt to interact with page
Expected Result: System logs out user and redirects to login page

Test Description: Verify account overview loads the list of customer accounts.
Test Steps: 1. Log in successfully\n2. Open accounts overview
Expected Result: All permitted accounts are displayed with balances and status

Test Description: Verify transaction history can be opened for selected account.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to account details\n2. Select transaction history
Expected Result: Transactions show date, description, amount, and status

Test Description: Verify funds can be transferred between two accounts in same bank.
Test Steps:
1. Login
2. Navigate to transfer page
3. Choose source and destination account
4. Enter valid amount
5. Confirm transfer
Expected Result: Debit and credit entries are created and balances update

Test Description: Verify transfer fails when balance is insufficient.
Precondition: Source account balance is below amount
Test Steps: 1. Login\n2. Begin transfer with higher amount\n3. Confirm
Expected Result: Transfer is rejected and account balances remain unchanged

Test Description: Verify transfer to external beneficiary is processed after validation.
Test Steps:
1. Login
2. Add beneficiary if needed
3. Select beneficiary
4. Enter amount
5. Confirm payment
Expected Result: Transfer is successful and confirmation message appears

Test Description: Verify same transfer request is not processed twice.
Test Steps: 1. Submit payment with same data twice\n2. Observe system behavior
Expected Result: Only one payment is created and second is flagged as duplicate

Test Description: Verify a valid beneficiary can be created.
Test Steps: 1. Open beneficiary page\n2. Fill in valid details\n3. Save
Expected Result: Beneficiary is created and appears in beneficiary list

Test Description: Verify invalid beneficiary data is rejected.
Test Steps: 1. Open beneficiary page\n2. Enter invalid name or account number\n3. Save
Expected Result: Validation error appears and record is not saved

Test Description: Verify new debit card can be activated.
Test Steps: 1. Open card management page\n2. Select card\n3. Click Activate
Expected Result: Card status changes to Active and user can use it

Test Description: Verify card can be blocked and later unblocked.
Test Steps:
1. Open card management
2. Block card
3. Confirm block
4. Unblock
Expected Result: Card status changes correctly and restrictions apply as expected

Test Description: Verify customer can raise a dispute for suspicious card transaction.
Test Steps: 1. Open transaction details\n2. Select Dispute\n3. Submit reason
Expected Result: Dispute case is created and ticket reference is shown

Test Description: Verify loan application can be submitted with valid details.
Precondition: Customer is eligible and all fields are valid
Test Steps: 1. Open loan page\n2. Fill application details\n3. Submit
Expected Result: Application is accepted and reference number generated

Test Description: Verify bank staff can approve valid loan application.
Test Steps: 1. Log in as bank staff\n2. Open application queue\n3. Approve request
Expected Result: Loan approval is recorded and customer is notified

Test Description: Verify repayment schedule is generated correctly after approval.
Test Steps: 1. Open loan overview\n2. Select repayment schedule
Expected Result: EMI amount, dates, and total payable values are correct

Test Description: Verify suspicious transaction triggers a risk workflow.
Test Steps: 1. Submit suspicious transaction\n2. Check system response
Expected Result: Transaction is held or flagged for verification

Test Description: Verify each role can only access permitted screens.
Test Steps: 1. Log in as customer, staff, and admin\n2. Try access different modules
Expected Result: Each user sees only allowed pages and actions

Test Description: Verify user can download a bank statement for a period.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to statement page\n2. Select date range\n3. Download file
Expected Result: Statement file is generated and contains transaction records

Test Description: Verify customer receives notification after successful payment.
Test Steps: 1. Complete a payment\n2. Check notification channel
Expected Result: Notification is sent with reference, amount, and date

Test Description: Verify admin can create or update customer profile details.
Test Steps: 1. Log in as admin\n2. Create/update profile\n3. Save
Expected Result: Profile is saved and audit records reflect the change

Test Description: Verify portal is usable on smaller screen sizes.
Precondition: Application available on different viewport sizes
Test Steps: 1. Resize page to mobile/tablet width\n2. Attempt login and transfer
Expected Result: No critical elements are hidden and forms remain usable

Test Description: Verify basic accessibility operations work.
Test Steps: 1. Use tab key to navigate form fields\n2. Check visible labels and focus
Expected Result: User can navigate without mouse and labels are readable
